goal: Reuse distance, time, and speed to compare how fast animals move.

activities.why: A shark cruising along a reef covers a distance that can be compared.
A journey also has a beginning and an end in time.
activities.big_question: Could two sharks swim the same distance in different times?

activities.why: Combining distance with time makes a journey comparison useful.
activities.big_question: What does a shorter time over the same route tell us?

activities.why: Speeds become interesting when compared side by side.
activities.big_question: Is a shark faster than a car in a parking lot?
